name: Sprint 5: production-path credibility

shipped: Deployed web apps work behind IAP (runtime dev flag, X-Fnol-Authorization); 3 redeploys logged in docs/deploy-fnol-poc.md
Policy-number oracle closed: last name + ZIP holder check, per-policy atomic lockout, agent-producer rule
One safe-pattern checker for tenant regexes at save and evaluation; AI output validation, tenant attribution, untrusted-input framing, labelled-name redaction
Security re-review closed 12 findings with real tests: 0 high, 1 medium (SEC2-011 residual), 7 low open
First live Gemini evaluation (640 calls, $0.59 GCP, 0 redaction leaks) and per-task model selection: local rules primary except subrogation on gemini-2.5-flash
Four production spikes (Cloud SQL store port, OIDC verifier, Pub/Sub outbox, KMS envelope) as design + tested proof
Demo test runs against a remote URL; golden sets at 20 cases per task (5 adversarial)
risks: SEC2-011 residual: lowercase, accented and unlisted-label names still reach cloud models
R2: devMode on in the IAP-only deployment (accepted PoC risk, Sprint 6)
Claude on Vertex not evaluated: quota 0 until the sponsor enables Model Garden
Intermittent CSR UI test under full-suite load (S5-QE-03 carried over); quality.json shows 1 failure
Remote demo against the deployed URL not run: needs an IAP token, blocked by session permissions

gcpUsd.note: Vertex AI spend billed to the sponsor GCP project, outside the $250 agent budget

goal: Verified live deployment, live-model evaluation, 0 open medium security findings, spikes for the four production gaps

went_well: Council caught real plan defects before any build (file overlaps, cost cap, IAP grant scope, R2 sequencing)
19 of 22 first-pass in waves 1-2; security gate found 4 mediums that became same-sprint fixes
The live eval paid for itself on its first run: a real redaction leak and a harness bug, both fixed and re-run the same sprint
The sponsor-reported outage was root-caused from logs without guesswork and fixed within one wave
went_badly: The review gate ran only e2e+security, so a UI regression escaped (DEF-001) and reached the sponsor
Orchestrator ticket scoping caused 3 rework rounds and one design defect (token-name identity)
Orchestrator ran git stash during a workflow (incident, no loss)
Quality report script passes a directory to node --test and always reports 1 failing test
manager_retros: workflow: identity checks need a product decision before code; last name + ZIP should have been the first design
ai: tests with fakes must be as strict as the real provider contract (schema-sensitive fakes)
quality: an intermittent UI test needs a trace, not reruns
